queries: Anthropic upfront payments capacity not built financing Amazon Google April 2026

sources_considered.why: Full text read. Establishes a contemporaneous financing and capacity agreement without establishing payment timing or funding necessity.
Primary filing read, including historical payment practices and prospective infrastructure risks. It provides important qualifications but no complete tracing of the cited raises.
Read as a guide to the filing; the primary filing was used for this claim.
read_page showed an October 29 update, after the evaluation date; that page version was excluded.

evidence_items.explanation: The announcement pairs financing with a large capacity expansion. It does not disclose a requirement to pay for unbuilt capacity or show that the investment was necessary for such payments.

evidence_items.locator: Risk Factors, page 76; related historical payment discussion on pages 75–76 and 146
evidence_items.explanation: The filing describes historical cloud-compute payments generally occurring as capacity becomes available, while anticipating more advance infrastructure payments. This qualifies the proposed mechanism but does not resolve the payment obligations behind the pre-May raises.

metric_scope.metric: Compute commitments and infrastructure payment timing

unresolved_gaps: No complete set of pre-May payment schedules was established.
No matching construction milestones establish that the relevant capacity was unbuilt when payment became due.
No treasury records establish that the cited financing was necessary for those payments.
The later filing's general historical and prospective descriptions cannot identify the use of each earlier raise.
